name: SciSpace
summary: AI research assistant for literature reviews and academic writing across 280M+ papers.
description: SciSpace helps academics search more than 280 million papers, run systematic literature reviews, extract data from PDFs and write papers with cited sources. It is aimed at students, PhD candidates and researchers. Paid plans start with Premium at $20 per month or $12 per month billed annually, with Advanced and Max tiers above it.
